title: 第15章 抢人大战初赛第16章 抢人大战复赛
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
落仙宗。
灵根测试广场。
数千人汇聚于此。
人们惊喜的发现，那些已死去的同伴，奇迹般的复活了。
他们互相拥抱，痛哭，扯淡，倾诉心声。
考核让他们经历生死，在生与死的边缘领悟生命的真谛。
不得不说。
落仙宗这一招当真高明。
不仅让这一届新人体验了生命的可贵，也让他们更加具有凝聚力。
对一个宗门来说，凝聚力才是真正的底蕴。
“找什么呢。”
王泽看着一脸严肃的李俊，开口问道。
“没什么。”
李俊回以微笑。
他其实是在寻找那战魔之人。
按理来说，自己带领众人与森林狼搏杀，斩杀狼王，冲上落日山平台，当属第一功。
如此对自己在落仙宗的发展有巨大帮助。
可人算不如天算。
后来又出现一个魔族。
且有人与之交战。

多亏此人拖住魔族，不然，他们所有人都要死。
想来。
此人怕是有可能与自己竞争第一人。
对于潜在的对手，他希望多有了解。
知己知彼，方能百战百胜。
他相信，终有一天。
自己会成为落仙宗之主。
与此同时。
广场的某个角落。
郑拓的表情前所未有的严肃，距离周围人保持两米的安全距离。
咋办！
被魔族惦记上，以后怕是寝食难安，随时都可能被干掉。
太不谨慎了，太不谨慎了，太不谨慎了。
早知道就不应该管赤枭的。
content_en:
Luo Xian Sect.
Lingen Test Square.
Thousands of people gathered here.
People were surprised to find that their dead companions were miraculously resurrected.
They hugged each other, cried, talked nonsense, and poured their hearts out.
The assessment allows them to experience life and death and understand the true meaning of life on the edge of life and death.
I have to say.
This move of Luo Xian Sect is really brilliant.
Not only did this new generation experience the value of life, but it also made them more cohesive.
For a sect, cohesion is the real foundation.
"What are you looking for?"
Wang Ze looked at Li Jun with a serious face and asked.
"Nothing."
Li Jun smiled back.
He is actually looking for the man who fights the demon.
Logically speaking, leading everyone to fight against the forest wolf, kill the wolf king, and rush to the sunset mountain platform should be the first achievement.
This will be of great help to his development in Luo Xian Sect.
But God's calculations are worse than those of people.
Later, another demon clan appeared.
And there are people fighting with it.
Thanks to this person for holding back the demons, otherwise, all of them would have died.
Think about it.
This person is afraid that he may compete with himself for the first place.
He hopes to know more about potential opponents.
Only by knowing yourself and the enemy can you be victorious in every battle.
He believes that one day.
He will become the master of Luo Xian Sect.
at the same time.
Some corner of the square.
Zheng Tuo's expression was more serious than ever before, and he kept a safe distance of two meters from those around him.
What to do!
Being noticed by the demon clan, I am afraid that I will have trouble sleeping and eating in the future, and I may be killed at any time.
Too imprudent, too imprudent, too imprudent.
If I had known earlier, I shouldn't have cared about Chi Xiao.
